paper_title: Earth as a transducer for dark-photon dark-matter detection
notes: Paper (Fedderke, Graham, Jackson Kimball, Kalia, arXiv:2106.00022) proposes Earth-as-transducer signal and reports 95%-credible upper limits on kinetic mixing epsilon from a search in SuperMAG geomagnetic data (detailed in companion arXiv:2108.08852), over 2e-18 eV < m_A' < 7e-17 eV (0.6 mHz - 20 mHz). The paper text provides only the mass range; the numerical limit values appear only in Fig. 4, which is not machine-readable here. The data_points are approximate representative values of the sliding-average limit (order 1e-6 to 1e-5) reconstructed from the known published exclusion curve, not from an explicit table — treat as approximate.
